properties.name: The four findings are four defects, not one pattern — rejected on the measurement it asked for
properties.rationale:
RECORDED BECAUSE A REJECTED IDEA THAT WAS NEARLY RIGHT IS WORTH MORE THAN A FORGOTTEN ONE. The four findings now stand as four, each with its own record and its own open question, which is how they were filed before the grouping was proposed:

· ② `dec:idea-should-there-be-a-typed-depends-on-and-the-existing-name-freed` — open
· ③ `dec:idea-should-edge-prose-be-governed-the-way-node-prose-is` — ACCEPTED and shipped 2026-08-31
· ①/④ `dec:idea-should-the-agents-own-word-get-a-first-class-record` and `dec:idea-should-a-large-node-be-changeable-one-field-at-a-time` — open

⚠️ WHAT THE REJECTION DOES NOT SAY. It does not say the four are unrelated — ① and ④ demonstrably share a cause. It says the SET of four does not, and that grouping them would have manufactured a systemic defect out of ordinary gaps. That is the over-engineering failure this project watches for, and the idea's own rationale predicted it as the honest counter-argument before the measurement was taken.

📌 THE GENERATIVE QUESTION THE IDEA RAISED SURVIVES ITS REJECTION and nobody has answered it: "where else does a reflow2 message tell somebody to do something no tool does?" The measurement answered it for four affordances, not for the instruction corpus. If that sweep is ever run, this is the node that asked for it.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary:
`dec:idea-the-instruction-layer-runs-ahead-of-the-typed-tool-layer` is REJECTED on Anthony's word, 2026-09-01: "let's go with 4 defects per your measurement."

The idea proposed that four findings from the 2026-08-31 field reports shared one cause — reflow2's prose names the right move and only the OTHER move has a tool. It named its own settling measurement: check each affordance against the tool surface. Taken 2026-08-31:

  ① answer a gap substantively   -> EXISTS (`answer_question` takes a `gap_id`, ask.rs:294)
  ② component DEPENDS_ON         -> absent
  ③ edge-prose staleness         -> absent
  ④ snapshot the replaced field  -> absent

Three of four, not four of four. The hypothesis predicted four and got three, so it is not the cause of the set.

⭐ THE IDEA IS REJECTED AND ITS INVESTIGATION IS NOT WASTED. The measurement it demanded is what produced `fact:reflow2-has-a-vocabulary-for-the-users-word-and-none-for-the-agents`, which explains ① and ④ precisely and claims nothing about ② and ③. A narrower cause with evidence replaced a wider one without it.
